chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from an-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Shu'ayb al-Haddad said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): A man from your mawalis sends you his greetings and wishes to marry a woman. She has suited him and he was pleased with some of her affairs. She had a husband who divorced her three times in a non-Sunnah manner. He disliked to proceed with marrying her until he consults you, so that you may command him. Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'It is the private part (of the body), and the affair of the private part is severe, and from it comes the child, and we are cautious, so let him not marry her.'

key_terms.اَلْفَرْجُ: The private part (of the body), referring to the reproductive organ
key_terms.عَلَى غَيْرِ اَلسُّنَّةِ: In a non-Sunnah manner, referring to a specific irregular form of divorce

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a woman divorced three times in a non-Sunnah manner according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises against marrying a woman divorced three times in a non-Sunnah manner, emphasizing the gravity of the 'frankness' (al-farj) and the origin of progeny. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on ensuring lineage purity and marital stability by avoiding potential complexities arising from irregular divorce procedures. The caution underscores the importance of verifying the validity of the divorce before proceeding with remarriage.
